features: Turbulent velocity over wall-distance frequency distinguishing near-wall vs free-shear regions where SST blending errors differ.
Signed adverse vs favorable pressure-gradient work relative to dissipation marking APG separation onset and FPG recovery where SST is wrong.
Bounded production-to-dissipation imbalance marking non-equilibrium separating shear layers and reattachment where eddy-viscosity fails.
Rotation versus strain relative to turbulence frequency distinguishing curved streamlines and vortical separation from attached shear.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless under V->2V, L->3L: Pk/eps=(V^3/L)/(V^3/L)=1, UgradP/(eps+abs(UgradP)) same units top/bottom=1, sqrt(k)/(omega*d)=(V)/(V/L*L)=1. Finite: eps>0 in SST interior so Pk/eps finite; denom eps+abs(UgradP)>0 strictly if eps>0 so bounded in (-1,1), avoids Umag=0 wall singularity of UgradP*d/(k*Umag); omega>0, d>0 off-wall so wall feature finite. All vary spatially (separation vs attached, APG vs FPG, wall vs wake) so non-constant and complementary to I1/I2 which lack pressure work, production-dissipation imbalance, and wall distance.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marking separating shear layers (Pk>>eps) and recovery (Pk<<eps) where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG work fraction; positive in adverse decelerating flow prone to separation, negative in favorable acceleration.

features.name: f_wdist
features.rationale: Turbulent velocity over wall-distance frequency distinguishing near-wall vs free-shear regions where SST blending errors differ.

proposal.risk_audit: Units checked: gradp_mag [L/T2] vs sqrt(k)*omega [L/T2]; UgradK [L2/T3] vs eps [L2/T3]; DUDt_mag vs Umag*Snorm vs sqrt(k)*omega all [L/T2] so all ratios dimensionless and invariant to 2x-U/3x-L scaling. Finite: f_pgrad 0/0 only if gradp=0 and k=0; f_trans denominator eps+|.|>0; f_accel denominator zero only if k=0 and DUDt=Umag*Snorm=0, all <1% points. f_pgrad complements signed f_apg with magnitude; f_trans is advection history distinct from Pk/eps production; f_accel is material curvature distinct from local I1/I2 S/W. Keep f_wdist despite -0.0788 gain because load-bearing (2 terms); drop unused f_noneq/f_apg (0 terms, 0 gain) to shrink search.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs turbulent acceleration; large at APG separation onset and strong FPG where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_trans
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs dissipation marking non-local transport history in separating shear layers and reattachment recovery.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration/curvature vs shear and turbulence scales; high over bumps and separation/reattachment with curved streamlines.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas are dimensionless (L2/T3 over L2/T3; 1/T over 1/T), denominators eps>0 and Wnorm+Snorm+omega>0 so finite everywhere, bounded in [-1,1] so no blow-up at walls. f_apg isolates signed APG vs FPG unlike unsigned f_pgrad; f_noneq isolates Pk vs eps production-dissipation imbalance unlike f_trans advection; f_curv isolates rotation vs strain + turbulence frequency for bump curvature, complementary to I1/I2 and f_wdist. Risk: f_apg and f_noneq share eps-regularized form and may correlate in shear layers, and saturate to +-1 in extreme events losing magnitude ordering; f_curv may partly overlap I1/I2 but acts as modulator not argument. Dropping f_trans (negative gain), f_pgrad and f_accel (zero gain, unused) to free slots and reduce overfit.

features.rationale: Signed adverse vs favorable pressure-gradient work relative to dissipation marking APG separation onset and FPG recovery where SST is wrong.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Bounded production-to-dissipation imbalance marking non-equilibrium separating shear layers and reattachment where eddy-viscosity fails.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation versus strain relative to turbulence frequency distinguishing curved streamlines and vortical separation from attached shear.

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (checked L/T units); denominators use omega>0 d>0 k>0 Umag>0 so finite on cell-center data, no log/exp overflow, ordering distinct from f_wdist/f_curv to avoid collinearity; bounded mapping handles large near-wall values.

features.name: f_pgwork
features.rationale: Signed pressure-gradient work vs local kinetic energy marking APG separation and FPG acceleration where SST fails.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration relative to turbulence frequency and wall distance marking curvature and rapid distortion in bump and CDC flows.

features.name: f_strain
features.rationale: Eddy-viscosity strain forcing vs kinetic energy distinguishing near-wall versus free-shear SST stress errors.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless by L-T check (Pk/eps; UgradP vs k*freq; DUDt vs freq*vel). Finite risk: Pk/eps and k in denominator blow up only where k~0/eps~0 (wall/freestream, <1% expected); f_bend denominator (Umag+sqrt(k)) zero only at no-slip wall. No duplication of I1/I2 shear magnitude or f_wdist wall scaling; f_apg2 replaces noisy f_pgwork (Umag in denom) with k*freq scale, f_bend replaces f_accel wall-singular /d with convective scale. Overfit risk low: each targets worst heldout bump_h38/h26 mechanisms (non-equilibrium separation, signed APG/FPG, curvature acceleration). Drop 4 zero/negative-gain features to free slots and remove harmful T2/T3 dependence.

features.name: f_neq
features.rationale: Production-to-dissipation ratio marking non-equilibrium separation shear and reattachment where SST equilibrium assumption fails.

features.name: f_apg2
features.rationale: Signed pressure-gradient work vs turbulent energy-frequency marking APG separation and FPG acceleration without Umag singularity.

features.name: f_bend
features.rationale: Mean-flow acceleration vs convective shear/rotation scale marking streamline curvature and rapid distortion over bumps and CDC.
